description: P1-04PWM is the drawing identifier for pulse-output controller module in AutomationDirect's Productivity1000 PAC collection. A pulse-output module provides the specified pulsed control interface from a compatible controller. Its function and connected equipment come from the selected control design rather than from a generic relay-output example.

For example, in a machine controller using a documented pulse or pulse-width command, use the P1-04PWM reference to coordinate pulse-signal connectors, compatible receiving equipment and module removal. Show the neighbouring equipment and the connection route so the installer can understand the intended arrangement.

Use the reviewed native drawing identified as PLC Families/P1000/P1-04PWM.dwg for the exact physical details. Locate the named file in its original manufacturer archive. Manufacturer drawing previews are shown only when an exact approved source is available. Any illustrative 3D view is a separate concept and is not to scale; use the selected manufacturer documents for dimensions, ratings and installation details.
readingNotes: Keep pulse-signal connectors, compatible receiving equipment and module removal visible in the layout.
